description: Currency conversion (reference rates). Use when a task needs an indicative conversion of an amount between two of about 30 major currencies (AUD, USD, GBP, JPY, NZD, CAD, CNY and others) at the latest European Central Bank reference rates, for estimates or reports, not for transactions. The ECB publishes the euro rates free of charge on its website. Cost: 1 credit per call.

amount.description: The amount to convert, as a JSON number. A numeric string is refused rather than guessed at.

from.description: Three-letter code of the currency the amount is in.

name: currency_convert
